actions.label: Mask
actions.effect: Cameras ignore you; hunters only see you if adjacent, for this tick only

actions.label: Sprint
actions.effect: Move 2 tiles this tick; cannot mask the same tick

actions.label: Dead drop
actions.effect: Hand the payload to an adjacent ally

actions.label: Strike
actions.effect: 1 damage to an adjacent target

actions.label: Heavy strike
actions.effect: 2 damage to an adjacent target

actions.label: Guard
actions.effect: Blocks the next hit on an adjacent ally

name: Decker
passive: Body is defenceless while jacked in; damage taken while jacked in causes dumpshock 3

actions.label: Jack in
actions.effect: Enter the Net from the body's current node

actions.label: Jack out
actions.effect: Leave the Net and return control to the body

actions.label: Blind
actions.effect: Disables a camera node for several ticks (cost: see net.costs.blind)

actions.label: Unlock
actions.effect: Opens a door node permanently (cost: see net.costs.unlock)

actions.label: Lock
actions.effect: Closes an open door node; a lock this tick beats an unlock this tick

actions.label: Break ICE
actions.effect: Removes a layer of ICE on a node (cost: see net.costs.ice)

actions.label: Burn implant
actions.effect: Stuns a hunter within range of the decker's node (cost: see net.costs.burn)

actions.label: Track signal
actions.effect: Follows the payload's signal from a linked node

actions.label: Plant ICE
actions.effect: Adds a layer of ICE to a node

name: Hunter
passive: Follows signal trails up to 3 ticks old

actions.label: Strike
actions.effect: 1 damage to an adjacent target

actions.label: Trap
actions.effect: Places a hidden tile that roots whoever steps on it for 2 ticks

actions.label: Mark
actions.effect: Reveals the target to your team for 3 ticks; needs line of sight to place

actions.label: Sell route
actions.effect: Reveals one enemy to your team, costs credits

actions.label: Bounty
actions.effect: Places a credit reward on a target

actions.label: Broker
actions.effect: Offers an in-match deal to any player. Disabled in AI-only play; see docs/DECISIONS.md

name: Receiver
passive: The match ends when this role holds a payload for 2 ticks

actions.label: Relocate the drop point
actions.effect: Moves the receiver location

actions.label: Read out
actions.effect: Downloads the payload while holding it at the drop point
